responsibility: This file models the D runtime entry points that generated code may call. It defines the internal enum of runtime function signatures and frontend `Type` caches needed to describe them, lazily builds `FUNCTION_DECL`s for druntime/libphobos helpers listed in `runtime.def` with appropriate call attributes, and provides `build_libcall`, the common helper used by expression and statement lowering to emit typed calls to allocation, bounds-check, array, associative-array, casting, exception, and contract runtime routines.
same_name_distinction: This is the runtime-call implementation file that lazily builds FUNCTION_DECLs and emits typed libcalls for compiler-generated runtime operations; runtime.def is only the catalog of helper names, signatures, and call flags that drives that construction.
